summary: Castellum, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a $32.8 million contract modification from NAVAIR for its GTMR subsidiary. The modification raises the PMA-290 Special Missions contract ceiling to $136.2 million under the SeaPort-NxG multiple-award contract. Only $1.1 million is currently funded, with work expected by March 2027; the rest depends on future tasking and funding. This is a routine government contract event with no change in control, capital structure, or special-situation characteristics.
